messages.text: Your order is currently shipped, not delivered, so it isn’t eligible for a refund through this process. Cancellation or changing delivery is outside the refund process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). I can’t arrange a refund for it now.
What can I do once the parcel is delivered?

Once it’s delivered, the cookware set must also be received back by the shop before you can request a refund. You’ll need to request it within 30 days of the recorded delivery time (refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/window).
